name: Ormer's Revenge
statusNote: Unchanged in Forever as far as is known: the text, objectives and rewards below are Classic’s.
footerSourceNote: Text, givers, objectives and rewards come from the cMaNGOS Classic database (a reconstruction of the 1.12 world), with what Forever changed on top: the game server’s own answers where we have them, else Wowhead’s Forever database. narrative.details: Now it's time to really make those dreaded Raptors regret their blood-thirst.  Just down below there are scores of Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws.  Make those rotten creatures pay by slaying 10 of each!
narrative.objectives: Ormer Ironbraid wants you to kill 10 Mottled Scytheclaw raptors and 10 Mottled Razormaw raptors then return to him at the Whelgar Excavation Site.
narrative.offerRewardText: You did a bang-up job of clearing out those Raptors, adventurer!
narrative.requestItemsText: I want to make those Mottled Scytheclaws and Mottled Razormaws pay for what they did. Have you killed 10 of each yet?
